quote: We use a widely-used crowdsourcing platform, Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT), to collect human feedback for our generated dialogues.

We use a widely-used crowdsourcing platform, Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT), to collect human feedback for our generated dialogues. The workers were presented with one entire dialogue and asked to rate (from 1 to 5) the entire conversation from three aspects: Relevance, Aggressiveness, and Overall.
